newsitem.title: UK: Ellis & Everard sees sales up 10 pct.
newsitem.headline: Ellis & Everard sees sales up 10 pct.

text.p: International chemical and polymer distributor Ellis & Everard Plc saw total sales rise 10 percent in the four months to August 31 over a year ago, chairman Jonathan Taylor told the annual meeting.
He said sales in Europe in the period were up nine percent over a year ago while those in the U.S. gained 12 percent.
"We are pleased with our progress in the first four months," Taylor said in a statement.
He said the sales gain came even though price levels in general had fallen.
Taylor said the strategy followed in the last three years "has served us well."
He said it had given the company "a solid platform for the future and we are determined to utilise it to achieve further improvements in performance."
